title: The dyadic prize domain is single-prime-power, so the BCH-window/dual-RS code is the COMPLETE & SHARP char-0 case; the prize wall is the char-0->char-p transfer of ONE proven theorem
evidence: The char-0 anchor is genuinely in-tree and PROVEN axiom-clean (PrimePowerMultisetWindow.weighted_windowed_prime_pow, [CharZero L] load-bearing): at n=2^mu, t<n, an N-weight power-sum window (sum_e w_e zeta^{j e}=0, 1<=j<=t) vanishes iff w is an N-combination of mu_d-coset indicators with d|n,d>t, so the dual-RS/BCH-window code's min distance is d*=least-divisor-exceeding-t=2^{ceil(log2(t+1))}. The probe C022_weight_window_charp.py tests the char-0 -> char-p transfer of EXACTLY this law over F_q with q=1 mod n a proper dyadic subgroup, q~n^4 (n^2<q, the prize regime), multiple primes per n, n in {8,16,32}, exact integer arithmetic. RESULT: the MIN-DISTANCE form of the law FAILS to transfer. char-0 min-dist (verified independently over Q(zeta_8): t=2 -> 4 on support {0,2,4,6}=a mu_4 coset, exactly d*) drops over F_q: t=2 -> 3 (<4) at every tested prime for n=8,16,32; t=4,n=16 -> 5 (<8). The witness probe C022_shortrelation_witness.py extracts the explicit obstruction: e.g. n=8,t=2,q=4129 a weight-3 kernel vector on support {0,1,2} with F_q weights [3352,2638,1] = centered integer weights [-777,-1491,1] vanishes mod q for j=1,2 but its Z[zeta_8] value is NONZERO in char 0 (reduced [-777,-1491,1,0] != 0). Same at n=16 (weights ~[-20250,-10931,1]) and n=32 (weights ~[-186269,-447043,1], q~10^6). These short relations have LARGE integer norm (~q/2), i.e. they are large-norm Z-relations of the 2^mu-th roots that wrap around mod the prize prime -- precisely 'short low-weight relations of 2^mu-th roots vanishing mod q but not in char 0'. So the connection's central thesis is CONFIRMED as a faithful localization: the dyadic prize lands in the simplest fully-solved char-0 radix, the char-0 case is sharp (verified d*, defect=0), and the only missing ingredient is the char-0->char-p transfer of this single theorem -- but that transfer demonstrably FAILS, and the failure object is the BGK/Lam-Leung-in-char-p defect carrier. No closure: the prize wall is reduced to (not lifted off) the same wall.
reduced_to: The char-p MIN-DISTANCE / BCH-window form of weighted_windowed_prime_pow: prove that over F_q (q=1 mod 2^mu, proper subgroup, q~n^beta) the dual-RS window code on mu_{2^mu} has NO nonzero window-t-vanishing weight of support < 2^{ceil(log2(t+1))} -- equivalently, that no large-norm <=O(...)-term {coefficient}-relation of 2^mu-th roots vanishes mod the prize prime. This is the exact, single-theorem char-p transfer statement (cleaner than the general delta* pin) and is IDENTICAL to the relation-free-transfer / GaussianEnergyBound / DyadicLacunaryFloor open core.
wall: W-LamLeung / W-anomaly (BGK char-p transfer): the short char-p relations ARE the large-norm Lam-Leung 2^mu-th-root relations that vanish mod q; counting/excluding them is the relation-free transfer wall (same as faces 3/4 of the open core and the GaussianEnergyBound deep-moment anomaly). W-Mersenne is NOT touched by this probe.
honest_note: Two scope notes for honesty. (1) The connection's PROPOSED probe (count {0,1}-indicator window-vanishing vectors that are NOT char-0 coset unions, expect <= q*eps* ~ n) gives DEFECT=0 at every (n,t,q) tested -- the defect does NOT live in the {0,1}/indicator stratum (with the POWER-SUM window, unlike C003's esymm variety which DID show {0,1} defects). The defect lives in the NON-indicator min-distance: the short char-p relations have large (~q/2) integer coefficients, not {0,1}. So C022's specific {0,1} measurement would mislead; the correct refinement is the min-distance/BCH form, which this probe used and which DOES fail. (2) The char-0 anchor itself is real and proven (re-verified the min-dist d* over Q(zeta_8) independently). (3) This is a faithful REDUCED, not a closure or a refutation: the connection correctly reframes the wall as a single-theorem char-p transfer with a known char-0 anchor and gives an explicit obstruction witness, but the transfer fails and welds back to BGK. Probes: scripts/probes/_407_conn/C022_weight_window_charp.py, C022_shortrelation_witness.py (exact integer arithmetic, n in {8,16,32}, 3 proper-subgroup primes each, beta~4). Recommend logging the weight-3<4 char-p min-distance drop + witness to DISPROOF_LOG alongside the C003 esymm escape.
